product_summary: Website www.mathewsons.com (group site, Cochin/Kochi, Kerala) lists 'Mathewsons Exports And Imports Pvt Ltd' explicitly on its Group Companies page. The published product range is a broad trading catalogue: building materials (cement, TMT bars, GI pipes/sheets, plywood, glass, paver blocks, kerbstones, bricks), fasteners (self-drilling/self-tapping screws, hex bolts, nuts, rivets, anchor bolts), PVC/conduit pipes and water tanks, scaffolding and formwork items, material lifts and platform trolleys, safety PPE (helmets, gloves, masks, goggles), ceiling fans, coir/jute/bamboo products, and a food line (frozen porotta, coconut products, tapioca chips, fruit puree) plus consumer goods (perfumes, soap, superglue). Declared codes 340319 (lubricating preparations), 843280 (agricultural/soil machinery), 846729 and 846781 (electro-mechanical hand tools / chainsaws) do not correspond to any product line visible on the site. Only a very loose link exists: 846729 could at best be stretched to hand-held power tools, but no power tools are listed; 340319 has no counterpart (no lubricants shown).
comment: HS mapping: WRONG. None of the four declared codes (340319, 843280, 846729, 846781) is corroborated by the published catalogue. The real product mix is dominated by building materials, fasteners, PVC/plumbing, scaffolding, PPE and frozen/dry foods - i.e. HS chapters 72/73/68/25/44/70/39/53/20/33/34/84/85. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is a clear misclassification: the site shows no oilfield, drilling or chemical product line; the closest items are perfumes, soap and superglue (ch. 33/34/35), which do not justify an oil-and-gas/chemicals profile. Trader signs are strong: the group describes itself as active in 'Foreign Trade' with 'strategic alliance with reputable international manufacturers', and the catalogue is a multi-category reseller range (cement brands, third-party glass, branded consumer goods) rather than a single manufacturing line - consistent with an import/export trading house, not a producer. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: fasteners (7318), TMT/steel long products (72), cement and concrete/paver products (2523/6810), plywood/board (44), flat and processed glass (70), PVC pipes and tanks (39), coir/jute/bamboo (53), frozen and dry foods (20/11/08), PPE (65/61/39), material handling equipment (84). Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection: the company stays in the base and the codes must be corrected to the actual chapters above. All product data here is from the company's own website catalogue and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this task (out of scope), so no shipment is confirmed. Note: no PAN, CIN, GSTIN or registered address was verified in this task; the Kochi address on the site (Next to St. Anthony's Church, Opp. Metro Pillar No. 568, Cochin - 682 017, exim@mathewsons.com) is the group contact, not a verified registered office. Search-engine access was degraded during this check, so no independent third-party catalogue (IndiaMART, trade portals) could be cross-read; only the official group site was available.
